item_name: Rothco Free Standing Mosquito Net Tent
item_short_desc: Rothco's Free Standing Mosquito Net Tent is the ultimate solution for insect protection. Crafted with a fine polyester mesh, reinforced with fiberglass poles, and featuring a durable polyester bottom, this net tent offers superior defense against pesky bugs. Its versatile design allows it to be attached to a cot or used as a freestanding tent, providing flexibility for various outdoor activities.
description: Rothco's Free Standing Mosquito Net Tent is the ultimate solution for insect protection.
